cover_headline: India Come From Behind to Beat Japan 4-1, Win Sixth Asian Champions Trophy
facts: Japan led from the third minute through Kazumasa Matsumoto; Shilanand Lakra equalised in the 42nd minute before India scored three times in the final quarter
India reached the final unbeaten, thrashing South Korea 8-1 in the semi-final after also beating Japan 4-1 in the league stage
The win makes India the first team to complete a hat-trick of Asian Champions Trophy titles

end.headline: India Come From Behind to Beat Japan 4-1, Win Sixth Asian Champions Trophy
end.line: Trailing from the third minute in Mohali, India equalised through Shilanand Lakra in the 42nd minute and scored three times in the final quarter to complete a hat-trick of titles.
